reported_success.location: Published p. 1406 (PDF p. 15), narrative following Table 10
reported_success.quote: No clear relationship was reported between vowel production and inhibitory control. In the current replication, the directionality of the relationships is as expected such that higher inhibitory control corresponded to higher perception and production accuracy. Nevertheless, no statistically significant relationships were found

notes: Original locator p. 23 corresponds to published Table 7; the retrieved accepted manuscript has different pagination (Table 7 on p. 32). Replication uses Spearman rather than Pearson because Pearson assumptions were violated (p. 1401). No conversion performed. Original vowel-production p is not printed; the unstarred coefficient is not converted into a p bound. No explicit effect-specific replication-success verdict for the original null vowel-production result was located; no success category inferred from nonsignificance.
